# 7427 - Triple 3-input NOR gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7427.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7427.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 9 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7427 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7427.png) | ![7427 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/nor3.png) | ![7427 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/nor3.png) |

The X box with three inputs.

How to tell it on a drawing: Three inputs, X box.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 2 | 1B | input |  |  |
| 3 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 4 | 2B | input |  |  |
| 5 | 2C | input |  |  |
| 6 | 2Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | 3Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 3A | input |  |  |
| 10 | 3B | input |  |  |
| 11 | 3C | input |  |  |
| 12 | 1Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 13 | 1C | input |  |  |
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 2Y = NOT(2A OR 2B OR 2C) | 2Y is the NOR of 2A, 2B, 2C. |
| 8 | 3Y = NOT(3A OR 3B OR 3C) | 3Y is the NOR of 3A, 3B, 3C. |
| 12 | 1Y = NOT(1A OR 1B OR 1C) | 1Y is the NOR of 1A, 1B, 1C. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 10 | 15 |
| any | Y | PHL | 7 | 11 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.

## Sources

- [TI SN5427/SN54LS27/SN7427/SN74LS27 datasheet SDLS089](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls27.pdf) - 1, 3; SN7427
